frequency_question: How often does an announced major industrial financing scheme reach formal gazetted implementation within one year of initial structural drafting?
membership_rule: Members: Centrally sponsored financial, credit-guarantee, or capital subsidy schemes for heavy transport, manufacturing sectors, or clean technology initiated by line ministries. Excluded: Routine budgetary allocations, tax rate modifications, and state-level (provincial) schemes.

validity_reason: Bureaucratic clearance procedures and inter-ministerial consultative speeds remain stable across typical government terms.
